item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - M2M- Shades Of Purple (2000) [Vinyl Rip 96/24]
item.description:
Recently got this album on vinyl thanks to a limited edition re-release. I don't have great equipment for ripping so expect some noise and clipping (especially on Do You Know What You Want, which was louder than the rest of the songs on the album) but I've done my best to edit these as needed. I believe this is a "new" master, some of the mixes are a tiny bit different EQ-wise and it really sounds great. If you are a fan and can snag a copy don't skip out on this one!
